review_kind: Claude AI translation and review (Claude Opus 5.5) on 2026-11-09 of the strings added or changed on the batch8-1109 branch against the exact English source: the MOA BENCHMARK and MOA BENCHMARK ARMS category hints of item 795 (the leave-one-compound-out mechanism-of-action benchmark) and the changed profiling_normalization tooltip of item 870 (ljosa_percentile scaling). No native-speaker sign-off.

records.source: How each feature is put on a common scale, plate by plate, against the reference: the negative control, or every well when none is named. mad_robustize: median and 1.4826 x MAD, tolerant of outlier wells; standardize: mean and SD; robustize: median and IQR; ljosa_percentile: the 1st to 99th percentile of the plate's control cells scaled to 0 to 1, as Ljosa et al. 2013 (BBBC021); tvn: mad_robustize, then the kept features whitened on the control wells of all plates, as JUMP, needing a negative control; none: unchanged. Default mad_robustize.
records.translation: Hur varje egenskap förs till en gemensam skala, platta för platta, mot referensen: den negativa kontrollen, eller alla brunnar när ingen anges. mad_robustize: median och 1.4826 x MAD, tål avvikande brunnar; standardize: medelvärde och SD; robustize: median och IQR; ljosa_percentile: 1:a till 99:e percentilen av plattans kontrollceller skalad till 0 till 1, som i Ljosa et al. 2013 (BBBC021); tvn: mad_robustize, därefter vittransformeras de behållna egenskaperna på kontrollbrunnarna i alla plattor, som i JUMP, kräver en negativ kontroll; none: oförändrat. Standard mad_robustize.
